<!--
PURPOSE
  Physiological condition at the end of the exposure. Sixty mussels of their own, not those of
  the thread and gene-expression analyses (T074 to T088 at day 0, T150 to T194 at day 3; a check
  confirms that none is in script 01's mussel key), were measured (shell length, height, width)
  and dissected, and their gonad and remaining tissue were dried and weighed
  (mussel-condition.xlsx). Two indices, recomputed here from the masses and the shell length (a
  check compares them with the workbook's rounded columns):

    condition index  CI = 1000 x tissue mass (g) / shell length (cm)^3     mg cm^-3
    gonad index      GI = 100 x gonad mass / tissue mass                   % of tissue mass

  (Moeser and Carrington 2006, J Exp Biol 209:1996-2003; Carrington 2002, Limnol Oceanogr
  47:1723-1733.) Tissue mass is the gonad and the rest of the tissue together. The masses are
  dry masses according to the manuscript's Methods; the workbook does not label them.

  Each stressor arm against the day-3 treatment control (15 mussels; 10 in each stressor arm): a
  one-way linear model of the index, the comparisons unadjusted and Dunnett-adjusted over the
  three (emmeans, multivariate t, seeded as in _ancova.R). The indices are analysed on their own
  scale, as condition indices usually are, and their residuals are closer to normal there than
  on the log scale (Shapiro-Wilk p in STATS_condition_tests.csv). In the same tables, as
  sensitivity analyses: the log index (arm effects as ratios); the allometric ANCOVA, which does
  not assume that tissue mass scales with the cube of shell length, nor gonad mass in proportion
  to the rest of the tissue (log tissue mass ~ arm + log shell length; log gonad mass ~ arm +
  log somatic mass; Packard and Boardman 1988, Physiol Zool 61:1-9; the fitted slopes are in the
  tests table); and a Kruskal-Wallis test across the four day-3 arms. The day-0 lab reference
  (15 mussels) is described and drawn, not tested: the day-3 treatment control is the only
  control (AGENTS.md).

INPUT
  ../01_mussel-measurements/mussel-condition.xlsx, sheet "data"   condition measurements (raw
                                       workbook, read only)
  03_analyses/01_build-mussel-key/mussel-treatment-key.csv   script 01's key (a check that the
                                       condition mussels are animals of their own)

OUTPUT  03_analyses/08_condition/
  DATA_condition.csv               every mussel: arm, day, shell dimensions, masses, CI and GI
  DESC_condition.csv               n, mean, SD, median, quartiles and range of each measure, by
                                   group (no tests)
  STATS_condition_tests.csv        per index and model: F for arm (and the covariate, with its
                                   slope), Shapiro-Wilk p of the residuals; Kruskal-Wallis
  STATS_condition_vs_control.csv   per index and model, each arm vs control: difference or ratio,
                                   95% CI, p unadjusted and Dunnett
  DIAG_condition_residuals.png     Q-Q and residuals vs fitted of the two models of record
  FIG_condition_index.png          CI by group, every mussel, Dunnett p vs control
  FIG_gonad_index.png              GI by group, every mussel, Dunnett p vs control
  RUN_provenance.txt
-->

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
```

### Packages, theme, palette, inputs
```{r message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
suppressPackageStartupMessages({ library(readxl); library(tidyverse); library(emmeans) })

# Scripts 04 to 07's theme
my_theme <- theme(line             = element_line(linewidth = 1.0),
                  rect             = element_rect(linewidth = 1.0),
                  text             = element_text(size = 13, color = "black"),
                  panel.background = element_blank(),
                  panel.grid.major = element_blank(),
                  panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
                  axis.text        = element_text(size = 12, color = "black"),
                  panel.border     = element_rect(color = "black", fill = NA, linewidth = 1.0),
                  strip.background = element_rect(fill = "grey92", color = "black"),
                  strip.text       = element_text(size = 12, face = "bold"),
                  legend.key       = element_blank(),
                  legend.position  = "none")

source(file.path(here::here(), "..", "tools", "plot_style.R"))       # colours
source(file.path(here::here(), "..", "tools", "pipeline_checks.R"))  # warn_unless(), provenance_lines()
source(here::here("01_code", "_ancova.R"), local = TRUE)             # ANCOVA_ARMS, DUNNETT_SEED, save_ancova_diagnostics()

repo_root <- psmfc_repo_root(here::here())
cond_xlsx <- file.path(repo_root, "01_mussel-measurements", "mussel-condition.xlsx")
key_csv   <- here::here("03_analyses", "01_build-mussel-key", "mussel-treatment-key.csv")
out_dir   <- here::here("03_analyses", "08_condition")
dir.create(out_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
if (!file.exists(cond_xlsx)) stop("Missing ", cond_xlsx, ".")
if (!file.exists(key_csv)) stop("Missing ", key_csv, ": run script 01 first.")

fmt_p <- function(p) ifelse(p < 0.001, "< 0.001", ifelse(p > 0.99, "> 0.99", formatC(p, digits = 2, format = "fg", flag = "#")))
p_eq  <- function(p) { f <- fmt_p(p); ifelse(grepl("^[<>]", f), paste("p", f), paste("p =", f)) }   # "p = 0.38", "p > 0.99"
GROUPS <- c("lab", ANCOVA_ARMS)   # "lab": the day-0 lab reference
```

### The measurements and the two indices
```{r}
raw <- read_excel(cond_xlsx, sheet = "data", na = c("", "NA"))
need <- c("mussel_ID", "mussel_trt", "day", "L_mm", "H_mm", "W_mm", "V_cm3", "total_mass_g", "gonad_mass_g",
          "condition_index", "gonad_index")
if (length(setdiff(need, names(raw))))
  stop("mussel-condition.xlsx lacks column(s) ", paste(setdiff(need, names(raw)), collapse = ", "))
norm_id <- function(x) {                       # scripts 01 and 04 to 07's mussel ID normalisation
  x   <- trimws(as.character(x))
  pre <- sub("^([A-Za-z]+).*$", "\\1", x)
  num <- suppressWarnings(as.integer(sub("^[A-Za-z]+0*([0-9]+).*$", "\\1", x)))
  ifelse(is.na(num) | pre == x, NA_character_, sprintf("%s%03d", pre, num))
}
cond <- raw %>%
  transmute(mussel = norm_id(mussel_ID), mussel_trt = trimws(mussel_trt), day = trimws(as.character(day)),
            L_mm, H_mm, W_mm, V_cm3,
            tissue_mass_g = total_mass_g, gonad_mass_g, somatic_mass_g = total_mass_g - gonad_mass_g,
            CI = 1000 * total_mass_g / (L_mm / 10)^3,
            GI = 100 * gonad_mass_g / total_mass_g,
            CI_workbook = condition_index, GI_workbook = gonad_index) %>%
  mutate(group = factor(if_else(mussel_trt == "lab_control", "lab", mussel_trt), levels = GROUPS)) %>%
  arrange(group, mussel)
if (anyNA(cond$mussel) || anyDuplicated(cond$mussel)) stop("A mussel ID does not parse or is duplicated.")
if (anyNA(cond %>% select(L_mm, tissue_mass_g, gonad_mass_g)) || any(cond$L_mm <= 0) || any(cond$gonad_mass_g <= 0) ||
    any(cond$somatic_mass_g <= 0))
  stop("A shell length or mass is missing or not positive, or a gonad weighs as much as its tissue.")

## checks: every mussel is the day-0 lab reference or in a day-3 arm; the indices are the workbook's
## (its CI is rounded to 2 decimals, its GI to whole percent); the condition mussels are animals of
## their own, none in script 01's key of the thread and gene-expression mussels
warn_unless(!anyNA(cond$group) && all((cond$group == "lab") == (cond$day == "0")) && all(cond$day %in% c("0", "3")),
            "A condition mussel is neither the day-0 lab reference nor in a day-3 arm.")
warn_unless(max(abs(cond$CI - cond$CI_workbook)) <= 0.005 + 1e-9,
            "The recomputed condition index differs from the workbook's beyond its rounding.")
warn_unless(max(abs(cond$GI - cond$GI_workbook)) <= 0.5 + 1e-9,
            "The recomputed gonad index differs from the workbook's beyond its rounding.")
key <- read_csv(key_csv, col_types = cols(.default = "c"))
warn_unless(!any(cond$mussel %in% key$mussel),
            "Condition mussels also in script 01's mussel key: ", paste(intersect(cond$mussel, key$mussel), collapse = ", "))

cond %>% count(group, day) %>% knitr::kable()
write.csv(cond %>% select(mussel, group, mussel_trt, day, L_mm, H_mm, W_mm, V_cm3, tissue_mass_g, gonad_mass_g,
                          somatic_mass_g, CI, GI),
          file.path(out_dir, "DATA_condition.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
```

### Description by group (no tests)
```{r}
measures <- c(L_mm = "shell length (mm)", tissue_mass_g = "tissue mass (g)", gonad_mass_g = "gonad mass (g)",
              CI = "condition index (mg cm-3)", GI = "gonad index (% of tissue mass)")
desc <- cond %>%
  pivot_longer(all_of(names(measures)), names_to = "measure", values_to = "value") %>%
  group_by(measure = factor(measure, levels = names(measures)), group) %>%
  summarise(n = n(), mean = mean(value), sd = sd(value), median = median(value),
            q1 = unname(quantile(value, 0.25)), q3 = unname(quantile(value, 0.75)),
            min = min(value), max = max(value), .groups = "drop") %>%
  mutate(day = if_else(group == "lab", 0L, 3L), label = measures[as.character(measure)], .after = group)
knitr::kable(desc, digits = 3)
write.csv(desc, file.path(out_dir, "DESC_condition.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
```

### Statistics: each arm against the day-3 control
```{r warning=FALSE}
d3 <- cond %>% filter(group != "lab") %>% mutate(arm = factor(as.character(group), levels = ANCOVA_ARMS))

## one model: F for each term (drop1), the Shapiro-Wilk p of its residuals, the covariate's slope,
## and each arm vs control (difference, or ratio for a log response), unadjusted and Dunnett
fit_vs_control <- function(index, model, form, is_log, primary) {
  fit <- lm(form, data = d3)
  covariate <- setdiff(attr(terms(fit), "term.labels"), "arm")
  slope <- if (length(covariate)) coef(summary(fit))[covariate, ] else NULL
  tests <- as.data.frame(drop1(fit, test = "F")) %>%
    tibble::rownames_to_column("term") %>%
    filter(term != "<none>") %>%
    transmute(index, model, primary, response = deparse(form[[2]]), term, df = Df, statistic_type = "F",
              statistic = `F value`, p = `Pr(>F)`, df_residual = fit$df.residual, n_animals = nrow(d3),
              shapiro_p_residuals = shapiro.test(resid(fit))$p.value,
              covariate_slope = if (is.null(slope)) NA_real_ else ifelse(term == "arm", NA_real_, slope[["Estimate"]]),
              covariate_slope_se = if (is.null(slope)) NA_real_ else ifelse(term == "arm", NA_real_, slope[["Std. Error"]]))
  emm <- emmeans(fit, ~ arm)
  if (is_log) emm <- update(emm, tran = "log")
  con <- contrast(emm, method = "trt.vs.ctrl", ref = 1)
  un <- as.data.frame(summary(con, infer = c(TRUE, TRUE), adjust = "none", type = "response"))
  set.seed(DUNNETT_SEED)
  du <- as.data.frame(summary(con, infer = c(TRUE, TRUE), adjust = "mvt", type = "response"))
  stopifnot(identical(as.character(un$contrast), as.character(du$contrast)))
  est <- un[[if (is_log) "ratio" else "estimate"]]
  vs <- tibble(index, model, primary, response = deparse(form[[2]]),
               contrast = as.character(un$contrast), arm = sub(" .*$", "", as.character(un$contrast)),
               estimate_type = if (is_log) "ratio arm / control" else "difference arm - control",
               estimate = est, pct_change = if (is_log) 100 * (est - 1) else NA_real_,
               SE = un$SE, df = un$df, t = un$t.ratio, ci_low = un$lower.CL, ci_high = un$upper.CL,
               p_unadjusted = un$p.value, ci_low_dunnett = du$lower.CL, ci_high_dunnett = du$upper.CL,
               p_dunnett = du$p.value)
  list(index = index, model = model, fit = fit, tests = tests, vs = vs)
}
fits <- list(
  fit_vs_control("CI", "index",              CI ~ arm,                                  FALSE, TRUE),
  fit_vs_control("CI", "log index",          log(CI) ~ arm,                             TRUE,  FALSE),
  fit_vs_control("CI", "allometric ANCOVA",  log(tissue_mass_g) ~ arm + log(L_mm),      TRUE,  FALSE),
  fit_vs_control("GI", "index",              GI ~ arm,                                  FALSE, TRUE),
  fit_vs_control("GI", "log index",          log(GI) ~ arm,                             TRUE,  FALSE),
  fit_vs_control("GI", "allometric ANCOVA",  log(gonad_mass_g) ~ arm + log(somatic_mass_g), TRUE, FALSE))
kw <- bind_rows(lapply(c("CI", "GI"), function(ix) {
  k <- kruskal.test(d3[[ix]] ~ d3$arm)
  tibble(index = ix, model = "Kruskal-Wallis (ranks)", primary = FALSE, response = ix, term = "arm",
         df = unname(k$parameter), statistic_type = "chi-squared", statistic = unname(k$statistic), p = k$p.value,
         df_residual = NA_real_, n_animals = nrow(d3))
}))
tests <- bind_rows(bind_rows(lapply(fits, `[[`, "tests")), kw) %>% arrange(index, desc(primary))
vs_control <- bind_rows(lapply(fits, `[[`, "vs"))
knitr::kable(tests, digits = 4)
knitr::kable(vs_control %>% select(index, model, arm, estimate, pct_change, ci_low, ci_high, p_unadjusted, p_dunnett), digits = 4)
write.csv(tests, file.path(out_dir, "STATS_condition_tests.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
write.csv(vs_control, file.path(out_dir, "STATS_condition_vs_control.csv"), row.names = FALSE)

## the models side by side: does any arm differ from control (Dunnett p < 0.05) in any of them?
calls <- vs_control %>% group_by(index, arm) %>%
  summarise(models = n(), below_005 = sum(p_dunnett < 0.05), min_p_dunnett = min(p_dunnett), .groups = "drop")
knitr::kable(calls, digits = 4)
models_agree <- all(calls$below_005 %in% c(0, calls$models))
cat("The three models make the same call for every arm and index:", models_agree, "\n")

primary <- Filter(function(f) f$model == "index", fits)
save_ancova_diagnostics(lapply(primary, function(f) list(metric = f$index, scale = "raw", fit = f$fit)),
                        file.path(out_dir, "DIAG_condition_residuals.png"))
```

### Figures: CI and GI by group
```{r fig.width=6.5, fig.height=5, warning=FALSE}
n_grp <- table(cond$group)
grp_labels <- setNames(sprintf("%s\nn = %d", c("Lab reference,\nday 0", "Control,\nday 3", "OA,\nday 3", "OW,\nday 3", "DO,\nday 3"),
                               as.integer(n_grp[GROUPS])), GROUPS)
grp_colors <- c(lab = THREAD_TRT_COLORS[["lab_control"]], TREATMENT_COLORS)
index_plot <- function(ix, ylab) {
  y_top <- max(cond[[ix]]) * 1.18
  ann <- vs_control %>%
    filter(index == ix, model == "index") %>%
    transmute(group = factor(arm, levels = GROUPS), label = paste0("Dunnett\n", p_eq(p_dunnett)))
  ggplot(cond, aes(group, .data[[ix]])) +
    geom_vline(xintercept = 1.5, linetype = "dashed", colour = "grey60", linewidth = 0.5) +
    geom_boxplot(aes(fill = group), alpha = 0.45, width = 0.6, outlier.shape = NA, linewidth = 0.6) +
    geom_point(aes(fill = group), shape = 21, size = 2.3, stroke = 0.4, colour = "grey15",
               position = position_jitter(width = 0.12, height = 0, seed = 20261019)) +
    geom_text(data = ann, aes(x = group, y = y_top, label = label), size = 3.6, vjust = 1, lineheight = 0.95) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = grp_colors) +
    scale_x_discrete(labels = grp_labels) +
    scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, y_top), expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.02))) +
    labs(x = NULL, y = ylab) +
    my_theme
}
p_ci <- index_plot("CI", expression(paste("Condition index (mg ", cm^-3, ")")))
p_gi <- index_plot("GI", "Gonad index (% of tissue mass)")
p_ci
p_gi

## check: the figures draw every mussel
warn_unless(nrow(ggplot_build(p_ci)$data[[3]]) == nrow(cond) && nrow(ggplot_build(p_gi)$data[[3]]) == nrow(cond),
            "The figures do not draw every condition mussel.")

ggsave(file.path(out_dir, "FIG_condition_index.png"), plot = p_ci, dpi = 600, width = 6.5, height = 5, units = "in")
ggsave(file.path(out_dir, "FIG_gonad_index.png"), plot = p_gi, dpi = 600, width = 6.5, height = 5, units = "in")
```

### Provenance
```{r}
ts_inputs <- c(cond_xlsx, key_csv, here::here("01_code", "08_condition.Rmd"), here::here("01_code", "_ancova.R"),
               file.path(repo_root, "tools", c("plot_style.R", "pipeline_checks.R")))
writeLines(provenance_lines(c(paste0("generated       : ", format(Sys.time(), "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S")),
             paste0("mussels         : ", nrow(cond), " (", paste(sprintf("%s %d", c("lab reference day 0", ANCOVA_ARMS),
                    as.integer(n_grp[GROUPS])), collapse = ", "), "); none in the thread and gene-expression mussel key"),
             "indices         : CI = 1000 x tissue mass (g) / shell length (cm)^3; GI = 100 x gonad mass / tissue mass",
             "model of record : index ~ arm (lm), day-3 arms, each arm vs the day-3 control",
             "sensitivity     : log index; allometric ANCOVA (log tissue mass ~ arm + log length; log gonad mass ~ arm + log somatic mass); Kruskal-Wallis",
             paste0("multiplicity    : unadjusted and Dunnett (emmeans mvt, seed ", DUNNETT_SEED, ")"),
             paste0("models agree    : ", if (models_agree) "yes" else "NO", " (Dunnett p < 0.05 or not, every arm and index)")),
             ts_inputs, repo_root, packages = c("emmeans", "ggplot2")),
           file.path(out_dir, "RUN_provenance.txt"))
cat(readLines(file.path(out_dir, "RUN_provenance.txt")), sep = "\n")
if (length(.checks$failed)) stop("check failed: ", paste(.checks$failed, collapse = "; "))
```
